update: One fixed rho=.03 moment update, no search or optimizer. In preBN coordinates this is m_new=(1-rho)m_old+rho*m_fit, v_new=(1-rho)v_old+rho*v_fit (no between-mean mixture term, matching a BN running-stat update). From fused preactivation z and original gamma,beta,var, compute a=[(1-rho)+rho*(var_z/gamma^2+eps/(var_old+eps))]^(-1/2), b=(1-a)*beta-a*rho*(mean_z-beta). Channels abs(gamma)<1e-6 retain a=1,b=0. Fold conv W'=aW,bias'=a*bias+b in FP64 then castFP16. Evaluate these actual folded weights with new detector forwards, not just reweighted cached scores. Finite coefficients required; no clipping/tuning. FP16 folding has rounding; no claim of exact real-arithmetic equivalence.
